verdict_row2.question: Was Theorem 1.2 hypothesis (ii) (asymptotic zero-free region at t0) verified at row 2 over all N >= N0, or only at N0?
verdict_row2.answer: Only at N = N0 in the Polymath record (paper, repository at every commit, wiki, issue threads). The only report of a sweep over all N >= N0 at row 2's parameters is a blog comment of 5 July 2024 by an outside reader, with unpublished code, no stated precision, no stated y-range and no stated threshold in the bounded range; the same exchange describes its tooling for a neighbouring computation as 15 to 17 digit floats.
verdict_row2.grade_of_hypothesis: not established in the published record; at most measured (one float route, unpublished, by a third party)
verdict_row2.disposition: attempt unresolved in the published chain (ALIGNMENT.md section 5, case 3); no evidence that the hypothesis is false

\begin{theorem}[Upper bound criterion]\label{ubc-0}  Suppose that $t_0, X > 0$ and $0 < y_0 \leq 1$ obey the following hypotheses:
\item[(i)]  (Numerical verification of RH at initial time $0$) There are no zeroes $\zeta(\sigma+iT) = 0$ with $\frac{1+y_0}{2} \leq \sigma \leq 1$ and $0 \leq T \leq \frac{X}{2}$.
